title: Require Research SDK Dependency Direction
forbids: Effect-bearing public contracts, inward contract dependencies, core dependencies on runtime, or semantic Bun dependencies in Git-owned mechanics
why: The package root and contracts are neutral data boundaries; runtime depends inward on contracts and core, and Git artifact mechanics must remain owned by the admitted Git substrate.
remediate: Move Effect-bearing APIs into core or runtime, reverse inward dependency edges, or replace Bun semantics in Git mechanics with admitted Git plumbing and tool-neutral helpers.
message: Research SDK dependencies must follow contracts <- core <- runtime, keep Effect out of the public root, and keep Git mechanics independent of semantic Bun APIs.
